description: Call any Proxmox Backup Server API endpoint exposed by /api2/json.

host.description: PBS host name or IP address.

token_id.description: PBS API token ID, for example puppet@pbs!puppet-token.

path.description: API path below /api2/json, for example /version or /config/datastore/{name}.

path_params.description: Path template values for placeholders such as {name}.

ssl_verify.description: Verify the PBS TLS certificate. Defaults to true.
